title: Rosalind and the Smile
author: Emrys Marchetti
blurb: Silas Winterbourne, the new teacher at a school with a missing-class problem, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. But when all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
